what_was_requested: Recompute the block-shuffle null for the cross-doc LODO probe at higher N_perm (>=5000) and at B=5/10/20, to push the resolution floor 1/(N_perm+1) well below the Bonferroni threshold 0.005.

resolution_floor_finding.implication: The published L24 p=0.0033 is the 1/(N_perm+1) RESOLUTION FLOOR at N_perm=300, i.e. ZERO of 300 block-permuted nulls equalled-or-exceeded the observed AUC=0.89415 (exceedance count = 0; p = (0+1)/(300+1)). It is a CEILING on detectable significance, not a measured exceedance rate. It sits BELOW the Bonferroni threshold 0.005 only because 1/301=0.00332 < 0.005; with one more decade of permutations the true p could be anywhere in [0, 0.00332]. The claim 'p=0.0033' should be reported as 'p < 0.0033 (0/300 exceedances at N_perm=300), resolution-floor-limited' — it is NOT a higher-resolution measured value.

why_higher_N_recompute_is_not_possible_f: Neither block-shuffle JSON stores the raw per-position probe scores, labels, doc indices, or block indices that the permutation actually shuffled. Only summary stats are cached: observed, null_mean, null_max, null_p95, p_value_block_shuffle, n_valid_perm. A block-shuffle null at higher N_perm requires the ORDERED per-position score vector + its block structure; these are absent.

results/p2_pilot/probing_dataset.npz DOES cache the raw residual-stream activations (X: 4400x10x2048, y, doc, gen_pos, region, layer_indices, token_id, rep_density) for the same 8-doc LODO design (3 pos + 5 docvqa ctl, 600 in-loop / 4400 positions). HOWEVER, re-deriving the probe SCORES from these activations requires the EXACT p3 LODO probe protocol, which could NOT be reproduced: every reconstruction attempted (logistic regression and difference-of-means; per-doc / global / train-only z-scoring; pooled and per-fold scoring) produced the WRONG per-fold AUC PATTERN. Observed target per-fold AUCs are {kshm_p6:0.803 (lowest), srgb_p2:0.976 (highest), pgjw_p5:0.904}; every reconstruction instead ranked kshm_p6 HIGHEST (~0.93-0.99) and pgjw_p5 lowest. Mean ranged 0.69-0.95 vs target 0.8941. The exact in-loop label window (the LODO summary lists per-doc loop_start = 512/1065/367), position subsampling at position_step=50, and/or feature construction used by p3_full_probe are not recoverable to the precision needed to legitimately reproduce THEIR null distribution.

Per heuristic #51 / the no-fabrication rule: recomputing a null from a probe whose AUC does not match the published 0.8941 would produce a p-value for a DIFFERENT probe and mislabel it as a higher-resolution version of the published result. NOT DONE.

honest_p_value_for_L24.correct_interpretation: p < 0.0033 (resolution-floor-limited, 0/300 exceedances at N_perm=300, B=10 and B=20)
honest_p_value_for_L24.note_B20: At B=20 the null_max rises to 0.8786 (vs 0.7887 at B=10), approaching observed 0.8941 — longer blocks preserve more autocorrelation, so the null is more conservative and L24's margin shrinks. L24 still has 0/300 exceedances at B=20, but with N_perm=300 the floor cannot resolve below 0.0033.

bonferroni_survivors.note: All 'significant' layers are at the SAME floor p=0.0033 (0/300 exceedances); the floor 0.0033 < 0.005, so any layer with 0/300 exceedances 'survives' Bonferroni trivially. At B=20 only L20 and L24 survive (L28, L35 drop out as longer blocks make their nulls more conservative). The survivor SET is informative; the survivor P-VALUES are all floor-limited and identical.

recommendation: To obtain a TRUE higher-resolution p-value, re-run the p3 LODO probe from results/p2_pilot/probing_dataset.npz with the original p3 protocol script (currently 'unknown' in provenance.json) and cache the ordered per-position score vector + block indices, THEN run N_perm>=5000. Until then, report L24 as 'p < 0.0033 (resolution-floor-limited at N_perm=300), survives Bonferroni at B=10 and B=20'. Do NOT report p=0.0033 as a measured value.
